name: apify-insights-plus
description: Chrome extension that adds ranged analytics and account-wide Actor views to Apify Console and public Apify pages.
author: Devansh Tiwari

scripts.build: VERSION=$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version") && mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/*.zip && zip -qr "dist/Insights-Plus-for-Apify-$VERSION.zip" manifest.json LICENSE content lib popup icons -x '*.DS_Store' && echo "dist/Insights-Plus-for-Apify-$VERSION.zip"
scripts.check: for file in content/*.js lib/*.js popup/*.js scripts/*.js; do node --check "$file"; done && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json'))"
scripts.test: node test/manifest-deps.test.js && node test/error-boundary.test.js && node test/range.test.js && node test/analytics-export.test.js && node test/context-cache.test.js && node test/api.test.js && node test/api-latency.test.js && node test/performance.test.js && node test/actor-detail.test.js && node test/profile-sort.test.js && node test/benchmark.test.js && node test/benchmark-source.test.js && node test/portfolio.test.js && node test/quality-inbox.test.js && node test/acquisition-triage.test.js && node test/today.test.js && node test/shared-helpers.test.js && node test/token-sniffer.test.js && node test/visibility.test.js && node test/actor-filter.test.js && node test/features.test.js
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/verify-package.js
